Lux Nitro touched revenue of ₹175 crores in its 1st year of re-launch.
Vertical B reported 50% volume growth in Lux Venus Rainwear and 10% value growth in exports in Q1 FY27 YoY.
Commissioned a 4.50 lakh sq ft facility at West Bengal Hosiery Park, Kolkata, on 5 acres.
Lux Nitro touched ₹175 Cr revenue in its first year of relaunch.
Vertical B sales quantity rose 16.3%, with Lux Inferno up 15% and Rainwear up 48%.
Management says it is investing in brands for long-term growth rather than immediate margin maximisation.

timeline.summary: Ashok Kumar Todi disclosed no encumbrance on Lux Industries Limited promoter group shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

On 23 April 2026 Lux Industries' board gave in-principle approval to demerge Verticals A and C into two separately listed companies after the Todi family signed a Family Settlement Agreement on 22 April 2026, subject to NCLT and other approvals.
On 18 May 2026, Lux Industries incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Lux Global Limited, with a share capital of ₹0.05 Cr to facilitate the demerger of Vertical C.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹873.01 Cr (+6.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹43.88 Cr (-8.8% YoY).

On 21 May 2026 Lux Industries' Q4 & FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 revenue up 13% to ₹2,929 Cr but EBITDA down to ₹165 Cr margin) and PBT down 37.68% to ₹137.51 Cr; with working capital days at 197.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹609.03 Cr (+0.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹22.13 Cr (-6.1% YoY).
Lux Industries Limited’s 31st AGM scheduled for September 25, 2026, at 11:00 AM via VC/OAVM; Record Date for FY2026 final dividend set for September 18, 2026.
